about: Wake scores to one detection: WakeScore.kt's rule, mirrored by android-app/tools/wake_score_test.py and the console's WakeScore (jarvis-web/src/lib/audio/wake.ts). Each case feeds steps [ms, score] to a fresh scorer; fires are the indices of the steps that return true.

cases.name: two frames in a row at or over the line fire on the second
one frame under the line breaks the run
a phrase held high fires once, then again the moment the refractory period ends
a clock that jumped back costs one detection, not hours
one frame is enough when the rule asks for one
